visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-definition close-up of a takeout lunch box filled with white rice, golden-brown fried pork, corn, and greens. A person's hands are seen using metal tongs to pick up and arrange pieces of crispy meat on a tray within a brightly lit food stall environment featuring stainless steel surfaces. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor night view of a local Taiwanese eatery. Several people are standing in a queue under fluorescent lighting. The camera moves towards the counter where an elderly male staff member works, and a woman in a grey t-shirt is seen scooping rice from a large commercial cooker in the background. (3) A large slab of breaded fried pork is placed onto a wooden cutting board and expertly sliced into strips using a large metal cleaver. Close-up shots emphasize the contrast between the crispy, rough exterior and the pink, tender interior of the meat. Side dishes like cabbage and corn are arranged in the cardboard box. (4) Detailed close-ups showcase various side dishes including bright orange carrots with egg, a slice of yellow tamagoyaki, a square of braised tofu, and savory minced meat with green pickled beans. The camera captures two small bottles of a yogurt-based drink held by a person against the blurred night background of the street. (5) The final sequence shows a handwritten red-lettered menu board on a wall, listing various dishes and prices. A street-level shot captures the entire storefront at night, bustling with activity, while text overlays provide the shop's name and address. A male customer with glasses is briefly visible looking at the menu.
